import numpy as np
from scipy.integrate import quad
import model

def qint(nu,k,w):
 p,c=model.coefficients(nu,k,w)
 A=-p*c; B=-1j*k*c
 z=1/(1-1j*w)*.75*nu
 Txx=z*(2j*k*A); Txy=z*(-p*A+1j*k*B); Tyy=z*(2*(-p)*B)
 # arrays mode amplitudes; integrate pair analytically, build F pair coeff
 # F terms order fields first array X, second Y, coefficient X_i conj(Y_j)
 terms=[]
 terms += [(A,1j*k*Txy)] # u dx tau
 terms += [(B,-p*Txy)] # v dy tau, each arrays need pair denominators
 terms += [(-1j*k*A,Txy)] # -ux tau
 terms += [(-1j*k*B,Tyy)]
 terms += [(-Txx,-p*B)] # -tauxx uy
 terms += [(-Txy,-p*B)] # -tauxy vy (vy=-pB)
 # Wait terms with negative incorporated, but last -tauxy*vy should first -Txy and second -pB correct
 I=0j
 for X,Y in terms:
  # .5 Re X_i conj(Y_j) / (p_i+p_j*) ; aggregate real after integration
  for i in range(2):
   for j in range(2): I += X[i]*np.conj(Y[j])/(p[i]+np.conj(p[j]))
 return -.5*np.real(I)

def pump(nu,k,w):
 p,c=model.coefficients(nu,k,w)
 boundary=-.5*np.real(np.sum(p*p*c))
 u=-p*c;v=-1j*k*c
 flux=.5*np.real(np.sum(u[:,None]*v.conj()[None,:]/(p[:,None]+p.conj()[None,:])))
 return boundary,flux, qint(nu,k,w),boundary+(flux-qint(nu,k,w))/nu
for k in [.7,1.3]:
 for w in [.5,2,8]:print(k,w,pump(1.05,k,w), 'old',model.reading({'wave_number':k,'frequency':w,'observable':'pumping'},1.05))
PY"
